diagnostic_bias.healthy_load_model: Paired network includes 430 ohm RREF/RTD, 1 ohm sense lead/contact resistance, pullup +/-5% and independent +/-14 nA input leakage; worst RTD=194.1 ohm error is 0.1845 mV, about 0.084 ohm or 0.22 C in this passive model
diagnostic_bias.runtime_fault_assumption: A conductor open is present before BIAS startup for the <=90 ms startup-open bound. For an arbitrary runtime break, the explicit third-order-boxcar phase model gives a conservative SENSE+ crossing at 28.912 ms (healthy 100 ohm to clipped full scale) and SENSE- crossing at 40.8998 ms (healthy 194.1 ohm to clipped code 0). Allow <=17.6 ms for one continuous sample, <=10 ms control poll including scheduling phase/jitter, <=5 ms sink, and <=13.8889 ms RC accounting: 87.3887 ms total. This is conditional on the model, with one contaminated sample possible; it is not a vendor-guaranteed runtime proof.

runtime_filter_evidence.bounded_model_assumption: The companion rtd_sinc_phase_model.txt treats the path as a causal third-order cascade of rectangular windows at T=17.6 ms. Its h3 phase response flushes in 3T=52.8 ms; a post-flush conversion can require one further <=17.6 ms period. This is a standard boxcar assumption, not a vendor implementation claim.
runtime_filter_evidence.closure_needed: Vendor step-response/order evidence or an instrumented arbitrary-break test must confirm filter history clearing and transition detection before claiming the 100 ms runtime requirement closed
runtime_filter_evidence.datasheet_facts: MAX31865 specifies a 60 Hz continuous conversion period of 16.7..17.6 ms and says the first conversion after enabling continuous mode takes the single-conversion time of 52..55 ms; it labels the block a 50/60 Hz digital SINC filter but gives no filter order, step-response, phase-reset, or transition-sample acceptance guarantee
runtime_filter_evidence.phase_crossings: Using normalized r=RRTD/RREF with conservative clipping to 0..1, SENSE+ healthy 100 ohm to high boundary 300 ohm crosses at 28.912 ms; SENSE- healthy 194.1 ohm to low boundary 10 ohm crosses at 40.8998 ms. The physical force/RREF path remains intact during the break.

rtd_measurement.critical_gap: The selected paired 1 Mohm diagnostics and 1 nF C0G with <=200 pF parasitic give worst temperature-adjusted RC tau 1.323 ms and 10.5 tau 13.9 ms. Direct hardware coverage now uses both TLV3201 comparators at protected RTDIN_P and the LOW divider bottom at RTDIN_N; it does not rely on the MAX ADC filter for conductor coverage. The 32768-corner passive model and separate ngspice case runs cover all four individual opens, accepted 1 ohm accuracy harness, 50 ohm robustness, +/-5 nA TLV input bias, board leakage, REF2025 loading, local-off collapse, and +/-45 V bounded passive transient current. Runtime digital freshness, MAX internal-switch behavior, comparator transient common-mode/output, EMC, physical wiring, and shutdown timing remain explicitly unproven; the conditional SINC phase artifact remains separate and must not be treated as vendor timing proof.

high_window_trip_boundary_ohm_estimate.meaning: The independent hardware HIGH comparator can trip before the 300 ohm firmware open threshold. It is guaranteed clear through about 262.7 ohm, corner/offset dependent from about 262.7 to 293.6 ohm, and guaranteed fault by 300 ohm under the declared model. This is intentional coarse-window behavior only if the system accepts the earlier trip.

rail_monitor.corner_method: Vtrip=(Vthreshold-Iin*Rth)*(Rtop+Rbottom)/Rbottom; independent +/-0.1% resistor tolerance, opposing +/-25 ppm/C TCR over 60 C, +/-100 nA SENSE current, and 1% threshold accuracy. Rising bound conservatively applies max VITN accuracy and max 0.825% hysteresis.
rail_monitor.ct_configuration: CT left unconnected; TI no-capacitor propagation delay is approximately 25 us minimum. No added release delay is assumed in the assertion budget.
rail_monitor.package: WSON-6 DSE, 1.5 x 1.5 mm, 0.5 mm pitch
rail_monitor.source_buck_feedback_assumptions: LMR51430 VFB 0.591..0.609 V, 100k/22.1k feedback resistors +/-1%, opposing 100 ppm/C TCR over 60 C, and +/-50 nA FB leakage; the source's declared 3.135..3.465 V envelope is retained as the acceptance bound
rail_monitor.verdict: PASS bounded rail guard: falling trip minimum 3.006010 V is above the MAX31865 3.0 V minimum, and rising clear maximum 3.114708 V is below the 3.1332 V minimum valid local RTD_AVDD rail. This closes the deterministic low-valid-rail release corner in the source/model envelope; reset transients, rail ramp, PCB parasitics, and physical loss behavior remain NOT RUN.

limits: The deck and Python generator are external passive/DC models; they do not model MAX internal switches, ADC conversion, or shutdown timing.

The unit passive harness transient contract is -0.2..+2.5 V per conductor relative to unit ground, source impedance >=1 kohm, edge time >=10 us, pulse width <=1 ms, repetition <=1 Hz. Its 2.7 V span fits the TLV3201 minimum 2.7 V supply, so the bounded comparator differential is <= supply and clamp sum is zero.

The MAX31865 +/-45 V RTDIN absolute maximum is a device limit only, not a unit transient immunity claim. With the allowed source contract, the 100 kohm RTDIN_P branch has no clamp current; a +45 V hypothetical device-only event is outside the unit contract.

The RTDIN_N LOW-divider path is included in the passive model; its threshold node remains within the TLV functional input range under the allowed envelope. A device-only +/-45 V event would drive the 10 kohm path into the TLV input clamp and is explicitly outside the unit contract.

The runtime transient model starts from healthy 100 or 194.1 ohm and opens each conductor independently using the actual C0G/parasitic RC. All modeled crossings are <=1 us; adding 55 ns TLV3201 and 10 ns logic propagation gives <=0.066 ms unit detector time.

Local post-ferrite loss is not treated as a powered comparator result. External source drive is forbidden while local RTD_AVDD is absent; the rail monitor/HW fault protocol owns shutdown. The passive stored-energy bound is 4.556 nJ into >=0.4 uF local capacitance, <=0.151 V worst rail rise, with clamp sum zero.

timing.critical_gap: The selected paired 1 Mohm diagnostics and 1 nF C0G with <=200 pF parasitic give worst temperature-adjusted RC tau 1.323 ms and 10.5 tau 13.9 ms. Direct hardware coverage uses both TLV3201 comparators at protected RTDIN_P and the LOW divider bottom at RTDIN_N; it does not rely on the MAX ADC filter for conductor coverage. The executable runtime model starts from healthy 100/194.1 ohm and opens each conductor; all four threshold crossings are <=1 us and unit detector time <=0.066 ms with sourced comparator/logic delay. The actual passive unit transient contract is -0.2..+2.5 V, >=1 kohm source, >=10 us edge, <=1 ms pulse, <=1 Hz repetition; clamp sum is zero and capacitor energy is <=4.556 nJ. Local-off external drive is forbidden and rail monitor/HW fault owns shutdown. Conditional SINC evidence remains separate and must not be treated as vendor timing proof.
